{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Drop QA and refunded orders for analysis
valid_orders = df[~((df['revenue'] == 999999.99) | (df['status'] == 'refunded'))]

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = valid_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate.max()

print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rate.round(2)}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.2f}%")"}
